subject: prd/implement-now
statement: Before counting a recognized e2e task succeeded, the executor shall establish that the test it authored is hermetic — a pure function of its declared inputs, yielding the same verdict on any machine and any run — and shall route a test that cannot be made hermetic to UB-17 rather than to the self-heal loop.
rationale: the executor's whole deliverable here is new blocking checks, and a check whose verdict depends on wall-clock, network, load, or ambient repository state is a measurement rather than a correctness claim; neither the e2e authoring line nor FR-8's CI mirror carries this duty
fit_criterion: each authored test returns the same verdict across repeated runs on differently-loaded machines before the task is counted succeeded; seeded wall-clock, network, ordering, and ambient-git fixtures are detected and routed to UB-17 with zero self-heal iterations consumed
